verdict.rationale: Sai can run tasks on a vendor-hosted cloud Windows computer as an alternative to the user's own device (BYOD), so a developer can exercise the agent on a separate machine before running it locally. The docs never describe that cloud computer as a sandbox, say nothing of containers, and do not document a test-then-promote workflow. Persistent setup and logins suggest a long-lived machine rather than a disposable sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/isolation guarantees, container or ephemeral/resettable VM support, a documented workflow for validating in the cloud before pointing at a real device, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the agent against a sandboxed VM or container before pointing it at a real device

citations.quote: Sai does it on a cloud computer or your own device, asking for approval before sensitive steps.
send a task in plain language, and Sai completes it on a cloud Windows computer.
Sai's BYOD supports devices including Mac mini, macOS and Windows.
